Step-by-step guide

It will be assumed that the user have several nights of data in some directory that will be called rawdir. Let us assume that the data are store at /data/raw: Our rawdir can be any of

  • /data/raw/2005-07-03

  • /data/raw/2005-07-04

  • /data/raw/2005-07-05

It will be also assumed that the data processing will be carried out in the workdir. In what follow it will be assumed that the commands will be issued from a terminal in workdir.

Setting up the processing environment

Copying PAF file

Copy the mefpp.paf file into the workdir.

$ cp wfi.paf <workdir>/mefpp.paf

Warning

Note that if this file is not present, the program will crash with some criptic message suh as “Segmentation Fault” or “Bus error.” It should be called mefpp.paf. It contains all the parameters for the appropriate instrument.
